book.name: Mwɛɛm mvù Jisos to duŋcɛɛ
book.title: Ŋwa' Mwɛɛm mvù Jisos to duŋcɛɛ ɛ̂ Jon

content: Bintee bi bisooshwiy bi shém Nyo' yì ffuuke le
Ɛ me nɛ n'yuw ɛ diɛw mi jemyi foweɛwe yew ncese yidvu le ɛ̂ bonceendaa bo Nyo' le bo bosooshwiy ba lɛ, “Ben egɛn etfuw shém Nyo' yì ffuuke yì nu ɛ̂ bintee bi bisooshwiy biɛ le yî nshɛ le.”

Ɛ nceendaa Nyo' wvu fwe mum gɛn tfuw kew kentee ke shém Nyo' yì ffuuke le yî nshɛ le. Ɛ biŋkokɛn bì bɛmte luci, kooyɛ bonyii bò to kɛŋke nciise nyam yì bɛmte yɛ nyaa mbense wvu baay ɛ̂ laŋ nyam yidvu.
Ɛ nceendaa Nyo' wvu bokaŋ bofɛɛ tfuw kew kentee ɛ̂ joo yi baay e, ɛ joo yidvu baŋke no nu diɛwɛ ɛlɛmɛ ke keŋkpwe ke wee le. Ɛ fiɛɛ ficii fì to cee ɛ̂ joo yidvu le kpwe.
Ɛ nceendaa Nyo' wvu bokaŋ botɛte tfuw kew kentee ɛ̂ jóo yì booke le noo mondvuum mò jóo buyte mó le, ɛ yí nɛ tu ɛlɛmɛ.
Ɛ me n'yuw ɛ nceendaa Nyo' wvù taale fô joo le jeme lɛ,

content.text: “Nyo', wo nu Nyo' wvu teytey ɛ̂ je yì wo sumtene bonsaw ban e.
Wo wvù nu keseen, ɛ wo to nu wase.
Bonyii ban nu bò ɛlɛmɛ ke bonyii bò ɛ̀ nu buw e
noo bonyii buw bo ntum e nu fobo fo bó.
Wo ɛ mum ɛ nya ɛlɛmɛ ɛ̂ bó, bó ɛ wu.

content: Ɛ me nɛ n'yuw ɛ diɛw buy fô ketaŋ ke ncese le bɛnse lɛ,

content.text: “'Ɛɛ Tata Nyo' wvù Kɛŋke Mvuŋgay Mvunciim,
wo sumtene bonsaw buw bii je kecɛɛy bô yi teytey e!”

content: Ɛ nceendaa Nyo' wvu bokaŋ bonɛw tfuw kew kentee ɛ ɛ̀ nu yî diuu le, ɛ diuu kɛŋkɛ je keekeyte lo ton'yi bonyii diɛwɛ ŋguy e.

Ɛ nton'yɛ wvu baay wvù to buyte yî diuu le no ton'yi bonyii. Geenɛn ɛ bó faŋɛ yaa ekumɛn lo mvuntelem mvubole, etumte ɛ ɛ̀ nu moŋkum mo Nyo' le kɛ. Ɛ bó kaa no beete lo bô diee di Nyo' wvù kɛŋke mvuŋgay mvu boŋgɛw ban e.
Ɛ nceendaa Nyo' wvu bokaŋ botin tfuw kew kentee ɛ ɛ̀ nu yî kawla nyam yì bɛmte yɛ le, ɛ woŋ wvù nyam yidvu to saake nɛ jiim lo. Ɛ bonyii no nu yî monlum e lumyi ɛlem ɛbo.
Ɛ bó nɛ no nan'yi lo Nyo' wvù nu we nje nlucɛ bô biŋkokɛn bibole. Geenɛn faŋɛ yaa ekumɛn gee dibole kɛ.
Ɛ nceendaa Nyo' wvu bokaŋ bosoocaan tfuw kew kentee ɛ ɛ̀ nu ɛ̂ joo yì Yuflɛts e, ɛ joo yidvu mum yum, keeseyse je wvu lɛ bonfon bò nɛn'yi ɛ̂ keba kè diuu sane le efey jó.

Ɛ me nɛ n'yɛn biyoy bì yiile bimew e bitɛte ɛ bí fieesene bisham. Ɛ bí buyte diuw keŋguum ke nyam yì fieesene nyam joo le, bô diuw nyam yì bɛmte yɛ le, noo diuw wee wvù mbiayte lɛ wen nu wee ntum Nyo' le.

Biyoy bin nu bonceendaa bo dɛwle le. Ɛ ɛ̀ nu bí bì gee mwɛɛm mvù duŋci mvuŋgay mvubole. Bí ghane gɛne fô bonfon bo bitum e bicii yî ɛkolɛ ke nshɛ le baanci bó lɛ bó eseyseè jem yì nu ke enu diuu di baay di Nyo' wvù Kɛŋke Mvuŋgay Mvunciim e.

Jisos to nu ɛ gay lɛ, “Ben eyekɛ eyuw, me nu ŋke enɛ nto diɛwɛ cooŋ e. Njoŋ wvu baay nu wvu wee wvù baa leete kɛ, wvù kɛŋke ndvú ye ye le wvu lɛ fo wvú ke enɛ etum ebuy kenyi kencimte ɛ́ bonyii eyɛn kencimte kew e.”
Ɛ biyoy bidvu ke mum baancɛ bonfon bodvu fô bvudvuu bvù bó teŋe ɛ̂ díɛw Ibulu le lɛ Amagedon e.
Ɛ nceendaa Nyo' wvu bokaŋ bosooshwiy tfuw kew kentee we yî fwefwe le. Ɛ diɛw mi buy yew ncese le fò kawla nu jemyi foweɛwe lɛ, “Fí ɛ ge wase ye!”

Ɛ jaŋ nɛ no lawkene, baykene, dvûmte ɛ nshɛ shiike bô mvuŋgay baay. Kɛ kfuu wvuwɛ nshiw wvù nshɛ to shiwɛɛ bô mvuŋgay baay nɛn to ke baa yuu nu wase dvú ɛ kɛw no wee to kɛwɛɛ enu yî nshɛ le kɛ. Nshiw wvudvu to nu ɛ bɛm baay.
Ɛ kelaante ke baay sɛnɛn buy biba bitɛte. Ɛ bilaante bi bitum e no keeshi. Nyo' to nu ɛ kume kelaante ke baay kin kè ɛ̀ nu Babilon, nya fiko fi shém ye yì ffuuke le ɛ wvú selle.
Ɛ bitum bi ɛ̂ joo ɛntelɛŋ bicii fɛɛ lo, ɛ dikum tɛn lakɛn lo.

Ɛ ɛbew yo baay baay no gbwekene fowe ɛ dimwaaŋ jite diɛwɛ bokilu mbaanyɛ le. Ɛ ɛbew yodvu gbwekene yî bonyii le. Ɛ bó no nan'yi lo Nyo', njefo wvú nu ɛ ciinse ŋgɛw ɛbew yî bó le. Wvuwvun ŋgɛw to bɛmte baay.
